fields.name: oauth_client_id
fields.description: Non-secret Client ID copied from https://api.slack.com/apps after selecting the app > Basic Information > App Credentials; blank means OAuth installation and token refresh cannot start.

fields.name: oauth_client_secret
fields.description: Secret copied from https://api.slack.com/apps after selecting the app > Basic Information > App Credentials > Client Secret; store it only in this credential field and blank means OAuth installation and refresh cannot start.

fields.name: bot_token
fields.description: Secret xoxb- or rotating xoxe.xoxb- bot token produced automatically by OAuth after installation; Dex refreshes it before expiry and it must not be entered manually.

fields.name: bot_refresh_token
fields.description: Secret one-use xoxe- refresh token for the bot token when Slack token rotation is enabled; Dex atomically replaces it after each refresh, while blank means the bot token is non-expiring or reauthorization is required after expiry.

fields.name: user_token
fields.description: Secret xoxp- or rotating xoxe.xoxp- user token produced automatically by OAuth for the displayed user scopes; Dex refreshes it before expiry and it must not be entered manually.

fields.name: user_refresh_token
fields.description: Secret one-use xoxe- refresh token for the user token when Slack token rotation is enabled; Dex atomically replaces it after each refresh, while blank means the user token is non-expiring or reauthorization is required after expiry.

fields.name: app_token
fields.description: Secret xapp- token from Slack app > Basic Information > App-Level Tokens; generate it with connections:write and copy the value shown once. Triggers receive events through Socket Mode with it; blank means a host that installed its own Slack app relays the events instead.

steps: Create or select a Slack app; under OAuth & Permissions add the displayed bot and user token scopes, then add the exact Redirect URI shown below.
Under Socket Mode, enable Socket Mode; under Basic Information > App-Level Tokens, generate an xapp- token with connections:write.
Copy Client ID and Client Secret from Basic Information > App Credentials and paste them below; also paste the xapp- token in app_token, which Triggers need to receive events through Socket Mode.
Under OAuth & Permissions enable Token Rotation only after this release is deployed; rotating bot and user access tokens expire after 12 hours and each refresh token is one-use.
